notes: 2603.15255 SAGE and 2603.15957 GASP: out_of_scope confirmed independently (A3). In SAGE, Challenger, Planner, Solver and Critic share one backbone, and all four are jointly LoRA-updated with Task-Relative REINFORCE++. In GASP, teacher and student share parameters and 'all updates are applied to the same weights'. The generated question pools are RL training data, not a retained harness component. Identification follows sol (C08 + H22, the run convention for proposer–solver co-training: r05b, r07b, r09b, r11a). evidence_level and claim_support are null, the canonical out_of_scope value; sol had written task/scoped.

2603.16060 ARISE (seat Δ11.25): final 43.75, below both seats (46.25 / 57.5). X, E.measurement and E.cost go to sol (2/2/2) and E.holdout to son55 (2). Shared correction on M (2 → 1): the paper's own selection rule gives one skill per query to all G rollouts (§3.2 Phase II; App. A.2 step 2), and the confidence gate is a query-level test (Eq. 7). So R=2 and R=1 never coexist in a group: groups are {0,1} or {0,2}, and Eq. 5's mean/std normalisation is scale-invariant. The hierarchical reward, called 'the primary driver of skill adoption', therefore cannot change the GRPO advantages as described, and the binary-reward ablation's reported −1.7 to −2.3 points and 73%→31% utilisation drop cannot follow from the written algorithm. With son55's finding that Eq. 6 gives selection/summary tokens no advantage, two of the three load-bearing claims are refuted by the paper's own equations. X=2 rests on separate defects (A2): new skills enter with u=0 and are the eviction target while selected skills keep u>0; 24 vs 5 seed skills; an eval-time library state that is not stated explicitly. E.measurement=2 follows the table-inconsistency cap (r09b, r11a ReCreate): the Table 2 full row (AIME25 49.1, Omni 28.0) differs from Table 1 (48.3, 26.8), and the 'every benchmark' text is false in 3 cells. RS → C03 and evidence_level retained (run convention, r08a EvolveR). Domain → H00 + H28; H01 and H26 are rejected.

2603.17187 MetaClaw (Δ3.75): final 41.25. M → son55 2: the meta-learning framing is not carried by any objective, mutual reinforcement is only asserted, and the RL-buffer rules conflict. Sec. 3.3 says the buffer accumulates across generations g'≤g*, Sec. 3.4 and Alg. 1 line 16 flush everything ≤g on each skill update, and Alg. 1 lines 7–10 admit only non-failure trajectories. E.cost → son55 1: the '5-day training run' is a wall-clock disclosure, the same level as r05a 'Agents of Change' (60 h wall-clock = 1). RS → adapt_via_conditioning/C03 primary with heterogeneous_decomposition supporting. Noted: the text says skills-only leaves Part I completion 'unchanged for both models', but Table 1 shows GPT-5.2 at 14.7→17.1.

2603.17613 VeriAgent (Δ2.5): final 38.75. E.measurement → son55 1, extended by an Opus recomputation of Table 2 (44 designs; valid designs 44/38/32/41). The reported 'Geometric Mean' row reproduces only for the Original column. Recomputed over each column's valid designs: ChipSeek-R1 0.310/92.9/1.80e-5 vs reported 0.329/112/1.93e-5; gpt-4o 0.345/129.3/5.85e-6 vs 0.362/122/6.89e-6; gemini3 0.286/103.5/5.31e-6 vs 0.294/109/5.72e-6. Normalising per design against Original, as the text says, gives geometric means of 2.49/9.44/9.99, not 2.196/5.119/8.539; the reported scores match the ratio of the reported column GMs. Power drops 17× at identical delay/area (comparator_3bit 0.1/11.704) and 1579× for div_16bit. claim_support → sol 'scoped'. RS → son55 (C25 primary, adapt_via_conditioning supporting); domain H00 + H01.
